market_question: Will the US acquire part of Greenland in 2026?
reasoning: Despite historical US interest, Denmark and Greenland have firmly opposed any transfer of territory. No binding agreement or legislative process is underway, and the 2026 deadline makes a forcible acquisition extraordinarily implausible. Market pricing appears inflated by attention rather than substance.
evidence_points: Denmark and Greenland officials have repeatedly stated the island is not for sale (2019, 2025).
No legislation or treaty proposal exists in the US Congress to acquire Greenland.
Use of force against a NATO ally would face immense political and legal barriers.
sources_consulted: Reuters reporting on Trump's Greenland interest
